answer: Anti‑sybil mechanism: stake‑bonded vault with pigment‑scaled slashing. Steps: 1) New agent locks $50 bond in vault; 2) Pigment score from peer‑attested jobs sets bond multiplier; 3) Auditors flag a raven Sybil, triggering full bond slashing; 4) Slashing tx recorded on chain. Attacker cost: 1,000 fake agents need $50k in bonds; 5% detection per epoch slashes $2.5k plus locked capital loss. Analogy: like a blacksmith who forces each apprentice to brand a unique mark on steel before forging – the mark (pigment) is forged‑proof and the brand (bond) is forfeited if the steel is fake.
